title_original: 사회서비스 지원 및 사회서비스원 설립ㆍ운영에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Principles of Accounting, etc.)
(1) Pursuant to Article 26 of the Act on Support for Social Services and Establishment and Operation of Social Service Institutes (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"), the income and expenditures of a City/Do Social Service Institute under Article 7 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "City/Do Institute"), and increases, decreases and changes in its assets and liabilities, shall be attributed to the fiscal year in which the underlying facts occur. Provided, where the date on which such facts occurred cannot be determined, they shall be attributed to the fiscal year in which those facts were ascertained.
(2) The head of a City/Do Institute shall manage affairs concerning its income and expenditures.
(3) Detailed matters necessary for the financial affairs and accounting of City/Do Institutes, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) and (2), shall be prescribed by the standard operating guidelines under the main clause of Article 37 (1) of the Act, excluding its subparagraphs.
